cases.case_label: Full-length L1 with 3' transductions in CHM (choroideremia)
cases.mechanism_detail: A full-length, highly active L1 carrying two 3' transductions is inserted in CHM in a choroideremia patient; his mother is somatic and germline mosaic, indicating retrotransposition early in her embryonic development. Effect on CHM transcripts is not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: analysis of genomic DNA from the CHM patient's relatives indicated somatic and germ-line mosaicism for the L1 insertion in his mother.
